name: Templar tank threat audit: Faith stays flat while Absolution's AoE taunt lands
contract: Faith 706466 (the Chastise/Faith Guard 705259 payload, client 'High Threat Holy damage') carries effect 63 SPELL_EFFECT_THREAT value 100 and a spell_threat pctMod of 2 (rev_20261103_01_templar_faith_threat.sql). Every other 'High Threat' ability in this codebase has a spell_threat pctMod around 2 (Heavy Blow, Hammer of the Law, Shieldgore, Chainwhip, Justicar's Wrath), so the tooltip-consistent expectation for Faith is the same ~2x threat_per_damage, independent of damage magnitude. The pctMod applies to the threat its direct damage generates. Faith's effect 63 reaches its target through Spell::EffectThreat (src/server/game/Spells/SpellEffects.cpp:4646), which calls ThreatManager::AddThreat with ignoreModifiers=true -- bypassing CalculateModifiedThreat entirely, so neither the pctMod nor SPELLMOD_THREAT nor the tank-stance multiplier (Rate.Threat.TankStance) applies to it; the +100 is added as a literal flat amount on top of the damage threat. data/sql/updates/pending_db_world/rev_20260909_04_templar_completion.sql also zeroes 706466's spell_bonus_data row (no AP/SP coefficient), so raising spell_power does not change its damage at all -- the flat/percent gap is visible at any spell_power, not only a high one. Absolution 800424 (client 'Taunt all enemies within 8 yds', aura 11 SPELL_AURA_MOD_TAUNT, implicit target 22 AoE around caster) must apply its taunt aura to a nearby target.

steps.label: Faith: threat is at least 2x its damage like the other High Threat abilities (spell_threat pctMod 2; the native flat effect 63 threat still adds on top)
OK: Absolution's AoE taunt applies to a nearby enemy
